case.summary: Monitoring flagged transaction 3445840 ($99.94) on card C03237-K1 after scoring 0.991 on the fraud detection model. Graph analysis revealed that this transaction and an earlier charge (3438063 for $99.95) occurred under holder identity region 264 anchor day 113, which was previously confirmed compromised in closed fraud case CC-5231. In contrast, legitimate cardholder activity was verified in billing region 272 from device D006776 with model scores below 0.005. Furthermore, device D003615 was tied to CC-5231 and linked to four other compromised cards within the seven-day window. The activity was confirmed as card-not-present fraud totaling $199.89, resulting in the card being blocked and a regulatory report filed.

sar.narrative: This Suspicious Activity Report details unauthorized card-not-present transactions involving customer C03237 and card account C03237-K1. Between November 7, 2016, and November 10, 2016, two unauthorized online transactions totaling $199.89 were processed in billing region 264. The initial unauthorized transaction 3438063 was executed on November 7, 2016, for $99.95 utilizing a newly observed device, D006648. On November 10, 2016, a second unauthorized charge of $99.94 (transaction 3445840) was conducted using device D003615, identified as an iOS Device running iOS 11.2.5 on mobile Safari. The bank's fraud monitoring model scored transaction 3445840 at 0.991, whereas legitimate customer activity occurred in billing region 272 from device D006776 with scores below 0.005. Both fraudulent transactions shared holder identity C03237-K1|264|113, which was established as compromised in historical fraud case CC-5231. Furthermore, device D003615 is tied to twelve historical fraud cases and was concurrently observed across four additional high-risk card accounts (C04661-K1, C06147-K2, C06374-K1, and C09530-K1) during the same weekly window. The recurrence of identical unauthorized amounts, compromised holder credentials, and shared device infrastructure across cards indicate coordinated card-not-present fraud. Card C03237-K1 has been blocked, connected accounts have been flagged for monitoring, and this report is submitted accordingly.
